citation.title: Risk-Aware Framework Development for Disruption Prediction: Alcator C-Mod and DIII-D Survival Analysis
citation.authors: Z. Keith, C. Nagpal, C. Rea, R. A. Tinguely

topic: Survival-regression and binary-classifier disruption prediction (time-to-disruption via RMST) on C-Mod and DIII-D flattop data.
own_question: Do survival models (CPH, DCPH, DSM) give longer warning times or better time-to-disruption estimates than RF and conditional Kaplan-Meier predictors?
actual_method_and_evidence: Uses 16 global signals (magnetics, EFIT, bolometry, interferometry) linearly interpolated to 200 Hz. Feature vectors are causal 10-slice windows. Data are one shot-stratified 60/20/20 split per device. Models were tuned with Optuna, and test-set metrics were bootstrapped over 50 resamples. The paper reports AUROC, a new AUWTC metric and RMST error. Its target is future disruption timing, not impurity-ion CES temperature. There are no BES/ECEI inputs, no real-time deployment and no cross-campaign holdout.

claim_checks.allowed_intro_or_theory_claim: Metric choice and hyperparameter-tuning objective can substantially change which tokamak predictor looks best. Machine-relevant evaluation should therefore be stated explicitly.
claim_checks.qualification: This is shown only for disruption prediction on C-Mod and DIII-D with one split per device. The figures were not visually checked.

input_target_timing_if_relevant: Inputs are causal past/present 5 ms slices. The predictions concern a future event. This is not current-report nowcasting.
validation_if_relevant: Single random shot split within each device; bootstrap on the test set only.
forbidden_inferences: Do not cite this paper for CES, ion temperature, BES or ECEI.
Do not equate disruption forecasting with our current-report nowcast.
Do not cite it as evidence of real-time performance.
Do not generalize it to all prior work.
reason_to_include_or_exclude: Off-topic for the core of our paper. At most, it could serve as an optional citation for metric-dependence in tokamak ML evaluation.
source_scope_note: All extracted page texts supplied; figure/equation visual validation remains separate
